preconditions.description: The number of integers n is between 1 and 32768 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) < 32768 for x in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each integer a_i in the list is between 0 and 32767 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The number of output integers is equal to the number of input integers n.

postconditions.expression: all(int(stdout.split()[i]) == min_operations(int(stdin.split()[1:][i])) for i in range(int(stdin.split()[0])))
postconditions.description: Each output integer is the minimum number of operations required to make the corresponding input integer equal to 0.
